rows.source_part: (iii) arbitrary common-base extension and (iv) product factors

rows.source_part: (iii) and (iv) canonical fibre-product identifications

rows.source_part: (v) left-factor cancellation and (vi) reduction cancellation

rows.source_part: (vi) the source reduction is a closed subscheme
